metadata.description: Primary references for risk-based testing strategy, shift-left gates, flake control, CI economics, component testing, contract testing, schema fuzzing, observability-driven testing, synthetic data, mutation coverage, test impact analysis, property-based testing, and shift-right techniques. AI sources are optional.

unit_testing.description: Component testing in a real browser using Vitest Browser Mode.

unit_testing.name: Vitest - Browser Visual Regression Testing
unit_testing.description: Real-browser visual regression workflows for component and page tests.

integration_testing.name: testcontainers-node
integration_testing.description: Testcontainers for Node.js/TypeScript; common choice for API + DB integration tests.

performance_and_capacity.name: k6 Documentation

performance_and_capacity.name: Web Vitals
performance_and_capacity.description: Core Web Vitals guidance for performance budgets and monitoring.

chaos_engineering.name: Principles of Chaos Engineering

chaos_engineering.description: Enterprise chaos engineering platform with attack library and gameday automation.

observability_and_tracing.description: Vendor-neutral observability framework for traces, metrics, and logs.

observability_and_tracing.name: Tracetest
observability_and_tracing.description: Trace-based testing tool for asserting on OpenTelemetry traces.

observability_and_tracing.name: Jaeger Tracing

synthetic_data.description: Enterprise test data management with subsetting, masking, and synthetic generation.

synthetic_data.name: Synthesized - Synthetic Data Platform
synthetic_data.description: AI-powered synthetic data generation for privacy-compliant testing.

accessibility.name: W3C - WCAG Overview
accessibility.description: Accessibility baseline; align automated checks and manual audits with WCAG 2.2 targets.

accessibility.name: axe-core
accessibility.description: Automation engine for accessibility rules; integrate into component/UI tests.

quality_metrics.name: Stryker Mutator Documentation
quality_metrics.description: Mutation testing guidance for measuring test effectiveness beyond line coverage. Primary 2026 gate for validating AI/agent-authored tests: line coverage measures execution, mutation score measures detection. Official VS Code plugin announced 2025-11-07, StrykerJS-only at launch (v9.3.0+); other flavors on roadmap.

quality_metrics.name: PIT (Pitest) - Java Mutation Testing
quality_metrics.description: De facto mutation testing tool for Java and Kotlin; bytecode-level mutation with Maven/Gradle integration. Version 1.19.x adds scmMutationCoverage, which delegates change detection to an <scm> block via Maven SCM rather than reading Git directly, for incremental PR-scoped runs.

test_impact_analysis.name: Launchable - Predictive Test Selection
test_impact_analysis.description: ML-powered test impact analysis; subsets CI test runs to the tests most likely to catch regressions for a given change.

test_impact_analysis.name: Datadog Test Optimization
test_impact_analysis.description: CI test observability: per-test traces, flake detection, early flake detection, and test impact analysis across languages. Renamed from 'CI Visibility' to 'Test Visibility' to 'Test Optimization' across 2023-2025; confirmed current as of 2026-07-11.

test_impact_analysis.name: BuildPulse - Flake Trending
test_impact_analysis.description: Flake detection and trending from JUnit XML reports; quarantine recommendations and owner attribution.

security.name: OWASP Application Security Verification Standard (ASVS)
security.description: Security verification requirements for planning test coverage and gates.

optional_ai_automation.name: OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications
optional_ai_automation.description: Risk categories and mitigations for AI-assisted workflows; treat as optional extension.

optional_ai_automation.name: NIST AI Risk Management Framework
optional_ai_automation.description: AI governance baseline; useful when adopting AI-assisted testing and triage.

optional_ai_automation.name: Meticulous - AI E2E Testing
optional_ai_automation.description: AI-powered automated E2E test recording and maintenance; emerging 2026 tool.

property_based_testing.name: fast-check Documentation
property_based_testing.description: Property-based testing for JavaScript and TypeScript; works with Vitest and Jest. Best-in-class shrinking; used for universal invariants, round-trip proofs, and AI-code edge-case discovery.

property_based_testing.name: Hypothesis Documentation
property_based_testing.description: Property-based testing for Python; integrates natively with pytest. Supports stateful (rule-based state machine) testing. Mature and stable as of Hypothesis 6.x.

property_based_testing.name: jqwik User Guide
property_based_testing.description: Property-based testing framework for Java built on JUnit 5. More feature-complete than QuickCheck ports for JVM teams.

merge_queue_and_ci.name: GitHub Merge Queue Documentation
merge_queue_and_ci.description: Official GitHub merge queue setup and configuration. Critical for understanding how flaky tests interact with queued merges and what checks to designate as required vs informational.
